mapper.insert: INSERT INTO canteen_order (order_id, username, student_name, dish_id, dish_name, portion, price, date) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{username}, #{studentName}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{portion}, #{price}, #{date})
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('ORD', LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1, 1), 4, '0')) FROM canteen_order
